messages.content: "compersion" word ta ki mane, kothaw dekhlam kintu bujhini

Compersion is basically the opposite of jealousy - feeling genuine happiness when your partner experiences joy with someone else, most commonly discussed in ethical non-monogamy contexts. Eta jealousy er opposite, jealousy na thakার mane na, eta ekta positive feeling jeta jealousy er sathe coexist korte pare.
